title: High-threshold and low-overhead fault-tolerant quantum memory
authors: Sergey Bravyi; Andrew W. Cross; Jay M. Gambetta; Dmitri Maslov; Patrick Rall; Theodore J. Yoder

title: Sparse-Graph Codes for Quantum Error Correction
authors: David J. C. MacKay; Graeme Mitchison; Paul L. McFadden
eligibility_evidence: Foundational sparse-graph/bicycle code benchmarking with plain SPA; a code-construction performance study rather than a proposed-decoder-versus-BP experiment.
edition_notes: Preprint 2003; published IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 50, 2315-2330 (2004).

title: Degenerate Quantum LDPC Codes With Good Finite Length Performance
evidence_location: Fig. 1 and simulation settings preceding it
eligibility_evidence: Standalone BP compared with BP-OSD-0 on generalized bicycle, generalized HGP, HGP and cubic codes. The inspected v3 specifies normalization 0.625 and 32 iterations.

title: Decoding across the quantum low-density parity-check code landscape
authors: Joschka Roffe; David R. White; Simon Burton; Earl T. Campbell
eligibility_evidence: Plain BP versus BP+OSD-CS on toric codes, with explicit scaling conventions in Appendix C.

title: On the iterative decoding of sparse quantum codes
eligibility_evidence: Ordinary BP is the comparator for freezing, perturbation and collision heuristics on bicycle codes under depolarizing noise.
edition_notes: Published Quantum Information and Computation 8, 987-1000 (2008). OpenAlex displays a shortened DOI different from the publisher-form QIC8.10-8; source identity is cross-checked by title/authors/year and arXiv. Other preprint/index records are not added.

title: Fifteen Years of Quantum LDPC Coding and Improved Decoding Strategies
authors: Zunaira Babar; Panagiotis Botsinis; Dimitrios Alanis; Soon Xin Ng; Lajos Hanzo
evidence_location: Sec. IV; Sec. V; Sec. VII A; Fig. 16 (PDF p. 21)

title: Neural Belief-Propagation Decoders for Quantum Error-Correcting Codes
eligibility_evidence: Untrained BP compared with trained neural BP on toric, bicycle and hypergraph-product codes.

title: Quantum Quasi-Cyclic LDPC Codes
evidence_location: Sec. VI B, Performance of Error-Correction
eligibility_evidence: QC quantum code constructions evaluated under syndrome SPA, with code benchmarks rather than a new decoder comparison.
edition_notes: Counted ISIT 2007 record; inspected arXiv v4 is an extended 2010 version. A separate non-DOI record is not added.

title: Trapping Sets of Quantum LDPC Codes
evidence_location: Sec. 5.1 and Fig. 9; Sec. 5.2.1 and Fig. 10

title: Toward a Union-Find Decoder for Quantum LDPC Codes
authors: Nicolas Delfosse; Vivien Londe; Michael E. Beverland
eligibility_evidence: BP is compared directly with Union-Find on a 3600-qubit 4D hyperbolic code. The appendix defines the particular iterative BP variant.
edition_notes: Preprint 2021; published IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 68, 3187-3199 (2022). Classifying as sum-product-type follows its tanh/product/atanh check updates; numerical conventions require separate reproduction review.

title: Combining hard and soft decoders for hypergraph product codes

evidence_location: Sec. 2 and Appendix D; Sec. 3 and Figs. 1-3

edition_notes: Published Quantum 5, 432 (2021); separate duplicate record is not added.

title: Exploiting degeneracy in belief propagation decoding of quantum codes

title: Refined Belief Propagation Decoding of Sparse-Graph Quantum Codes

edition_notes: Published IEEE J. Sel. Areas Inf. Theory 1(2), 487-498 (2020); not the separate scalar-message conference paper.

title: Enhanced Feedback Iterative Decoding of Sparse Quantum Codes
authors: Yun-Jiang Wang; Barry C. Sanders; Bao-Ming Bai; Xin-Mei Wang

edition_notes: Preprint 2009; published IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 58, 1231-1241 (2012). Repository-like duplicate indexed as 2016 is not added.

title: Belief Propagation Decoding of Quantum LDPC Codes with Guided Decimation
authors: Hanwen Yao; Waleed Abu Laban; Christian Hager; Alexandre Graell i Amat; Henry D. Pfister

edition_notes: Preprint 2023; counted OpenAlex record is the ISIT 2024 publication. Baseline details are checked in the fuller arXiv v2, not asserted to be identical to every conference-version detail.
